l1_words.meaning: a figure of speech that describes one thing as another
a contrast between what is said and what is meant
a story or account of a sequence of events
a serious work in which the main character suffers a great loss

pattern_explanation: Each English word shares its spelling and meaning with its Portuguese counterpart because both languages inherited the terms from Latin and Greek literary vocabulary. The English list is shuffled so the matching is not simply in the same order.
